description: SlickTrip watches flight, hotel and seat prices and tells you when they move. Search flights and hotels with live prices, see the cheapest days on a calendar, and check which seats are open on a flight. Then set an alert: a specific fare, a hotel stay, a seat, or a bucket list for a route or a place with flexible dates. SlickTrip keeps checking and emails or texts you when the price drops or a seat opens. Searching works without an account; alerts need a free SlickTrip login. Booking happens on the airline's or hotel seller's own site, and every result opens on slicktrip.com fully configured.

defaultPrompt: Tell me when New York to Tokyo drops under $700 this winter
When is it cheapest to fly Chicago to Cancun, and watch it for me
Which seats are open on AA100 to London tomorrow
